description: Import AGENTS.md (the OpenAI/Codex convention) into project.faf, or write it from project.faf. Returns the merged or written result for the chosen action. Use this to keep a Codex/OpenAI-style AGENTS.md and your .faf in agreement from one source.

action.description: Action: import (AGENTS.md -> .faf; merge:true writes it into project.faf), export (.faf -> AGENTS.md), sync (re-writes AGENTS.md from .faf; export with force)

force.description: Update the faf-managed block in an existing file (content outside it is preserved)

merge.description: Write the imported data into project.faf (without it, import only reports the section count and writes nothing)

path.description: Project path. Sets session context for subsequent calls.

name: faf_agents
